citeAs: Awadalla, A., Xue, L., Lo, O., Shu, M., Lee, H., Guha, E., Jordan, M., Shen, S., Awadalla, M., Savarese, S., Xiong, C., Xu, R., Choi, Y., & Schmidt, L. (2024). MINT-1T: Scaling Open-Source Multimodal Data by 10x: A Multimodal Dataset with One Trillion Tokens. arXiv preprint arXiv:2406.11271.
creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
description: MINT-1T is a one trillion token multimodal interleaved pre-training dataset comprising free-form interleaved sequences of images and text sourced from HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv.
name: MINT-1T
publisher: University of Washington, Salesforce Research, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, and University of California Berkeley
rai:dataBiases: We follow previous works in not using text quality classifier models as they have been shown to favor text from certain demographics.
rai:dataCollection: MINT-1T’s HTML documents are filtered from CommonCrawl WARC dumps from 2017 to 2024 based on text quality, the presence of duplicated and undesirable content, and availability of images for downloading. MINT-1T PDF documents are filtered from CommonCrawl WAT dumps from 2023 to 2024... MINT-1T ArXiv documents is a subset of all ArXiv documents.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The data comes from CommonCrawl dumps and directly from ArXiv S3 buckets for ArXiv documents.
rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The data was collected from January 2024 to June 2024. We include web data from 2013 to 2024.
rai:dataLimitations: we sometimes are unable to detect images 2) as PDFs have arbitrary layouts, in some cases we extract an incorrect reading order
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Eliminate non-English documents using Fasttext’s language identification model, remove documents with URLs containing NSFW substrings, remove documents with excessive duplicate n-grams or those identified as low quality using MassiveText rules, remove images smaller than 150 pixels or larger than 20,000 pixels, remove images with an aspect ratio greater than two (or three for PDFs), apply an NSFW image detector, anonymize email addresses and IP addresses, and perform paragraph, document, and image deduplication.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: This work’s authors will actively respond to issues in MINT-1T and maintain the dataset... Yes the dataset will be updated by the authors of this work. We will communicate updates through the README in the Huggingface interface.
rai:dataSocialImpact: An important consideration when releasing large datasets is to avoid exposing harmful content from the web. We were careful about filtering out personally identifiable information and not safe for work content from MINT-1T.
rai:dataUseCases: MINT-1T is built for pre-training large multimodal models that can process multiple interleaved images and text. The dataset can be used for other training objectives like generating interleaved images and text sequences or for building multimodal document retrieval systems.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Fasttext’s language identification model, NSFW image detector
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Personally Identifiable Information Removal To mitigate the risk of personal data leakage, we anonymize email addresses and IP addresses in our text data.

null_reasons.rai:annotationsPerItem: Dataset is scraped from the web, not manually annotated.
null_reasons.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: No explicit discussion of missing data handling beyond filtering out invalid links.
null_reasons.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: No post-preprocessing manipulation like augmentation described for the dataset itself.
